# Agent Skills Setup (skills-repo)

> An agent-first Skill for migrating selected AI coding context with the host agent's existing tools. No bundled migration runtime or installer.

The current development tree is unreleased (0.11.0-dev). Published 0.10.x packages still contain the retired engine. Product references are documentation evidence, not certified runtime compatibility.

## Documentation
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/README.md): Installation scope, usage prompts, development status and evidence limits.
- [Canonical Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/skills/agent-skills-setup/SKILL.md): Discovery, scoped edits, verification and authorization boundaries.
- [Product Catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/skills/agent-skills-setup/references/products.md): Version-sensitive product/profile routing, including separate Gemini CLI and Antigravity profiles.
- [Full Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/llms-full.txt): Single-fetch copy of the canonical Skill, all current references and migration templates. No retired CLI recipes or ACB protocol.

## Optional
- [Validation Status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/docs/validation-status.md): Checks performed and real-client evidence still required.
- [Release Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/CHANGELOG.md): Development and release history.
